item.tib: rig 'dzin bsgrubs pa'i cha lag chung shas bskangs glud btang pa
item.coloph: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bsgrubs (sgrub) pa las/ chung shos bskangs (skong) glud bstan pa 'di/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la brgyud pa'o/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod pa gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
